# Dispute Mail

> Dispute credit errors, debt, and billing issues with confidence.

Dispute Mail is a standalone product that provides guided workflows for preparing dispute letters — credit report errors, debt validation requests, billing errors, and unauthorized charges — and sends them as physical mail via USPS with tracking and proof of delivery.

## What it does
- Guides users through step-by-step dispute workflows (not blank-page AI chat)
- Provides AI-assisted drafting that remains editable — AI never invents facts or legal conclusions
- Sends physical mail (First-Class, Certified, Certified with Return Receipt, Registered) with tracking
- Retains mailing records including tracking numbers and proof of timely submission
- Provides a dashboard for viewing mailing history and tracking status

## Important limitations
Dispute Mail is NOT a law firm and does not provide legal advice.

## Primary workflows
1. Dispute a Credit Report Error (FCRA)
2. Request Debt Validation (FDCPA)
3. Dispute a Billing Error
4. Dispute an Unauthorized Charge

## Technology
- Built on TanStack Start (React + TanStack Router) with SSR
- Deployed on Cloudflare Pages
- Physical mail fulfillment via MailMyPDF v1 API
